claim: 3D printing, also known as additive manufacturing, constructs three-dimensional objects from CAD or digital 3D models.
quote: 3D printing , also called additive manufacturing , is the construction of a three-dimensional object from a CAD model or a digital 3D model .

claim: 3D printing involves processes where material is deposited, joined, or solidified under computer control, typically layer by layer.
quote: It can be done in a variety of processes in which material is deposited, joined or solidified under computer control , with the material being added together...

claim: Fused deposition modeling (FDM) is the most common 3D printing process as of 2020.
quote: Fused deposition modeling (FDM), which uses a continuous filament of a thermoplastic material, is the most common 3D printing process in use as of 2020.

claim: Additive manufacturing is often used synonymously with 3D printing in industrial contexts.
quote: the term additive manufacturing can be used synonymously with 3D printing.

claim: 3D printing allows for the production of complex shapes or geometries that are difficult to construct by hand.
quote: One of the key advantages of 3D printing is the ability to produce very complex shapes or geometries that would be otherwise infeasible to construct by hand.

claim: The term 'additive manufacturing' gained popularity in the 2000s, contrasting with 'subtractive manufacturing'.
quote: The umbrella term additive manufacturing (AM) gained popularity in the 2000s...In contrast, the term subtractive manufacturing appeared as a retronym...

claim: 3D printing and additive manufacturing are alternate umbrella terms for additive technologies.
quote: the terms 3D printing and additive manufacturing evolved senses in which they were alternate umbrella terms for additive technologies.

claim: ANSI defines additive manufacturing as building parts from 3D model data by adding material layer by layer.
quote: ANSI says that international standards such as IS0/ASTM 52900 define additive manufacturing as the process of building parts from 3D model data and adding material layer by layer.

claim: 3D printing is described as creating objects by depositing material through a print head or nozzle device.
quote: 3D printing is described as creating objects by depositing material through a print head or some variation of a nozzle type of device.

claim: 3D concrete printing refers to digital fabrication processes for cementitious materials using 3D printing technologies.
quote: 3D concrete printing , or simply concrete printing , refers to digital fabrication processes for cementitious materials based on one of several different 3D printing technologies.

claim: 3D-printed concrete eliminates the need for formwork, reducing material waste and allowing for greater geometric freedom.
quote: 3D-printed concrete eliminates the need for formwork, reducing material waste and allowing for greater geometric freedom in complex structures.

claim: 3D concrete printing has applications in producing building blocks, modules, street furniture, bridges, and residential structures.
quote: Architectural and structural applications of 3D-printed concrete include the production of building blocks , building modules , street furniture , pedestrian bridges, and low-rise residential structures.

claim: Binder jetting, robotic shotcrete, and layered material extrusion are methods used in 3D concrete printing.
quote: Three different construction methods are currently used in 3D concrete printing: binder jetting , robotic shotcrete , [ 10 ] and layered material extrusion .

claim: Binder jet 3D printing involves depositing a liquid binder on a powdered substrate, layer by layer.
quote: In binder jetting , a print head selectively deposits a liquid binder on a powdered substrate, layer by layer.

claim: Concrete layered extrusion 3D printing uses a nozzle to extrude cementitious paste layer by layer.
quote: Concrete layered extrusion 3D printing involves a numerically controlled nozzle that precisely extrudes a cementitious paste layer by layer.

claim: CoreXY is a kinematic motion system used in 3D printers to move the printhead in the horizontal plane.
quote: CoreXY is a kinematic motion system, popularized by its use to move the printhead of a 3D printer , or the toolhead in CNC machines, in the horizontal plane.

claim: CoreXY uses stationary motors and drive belts to reduce moving mass and increase printing speed.
quote: The advantage of this technique is that the two motors used to perform the movement in the horizontal plane are stationary and do not have to move themselves, which can result in less moving mass.

claim: CoreXY provides movement in a Cartesian coordinate system using an intricate belt system.
quote: Instead, drive belts are used which are connected in an intricate way to provide movement in a Cartesian coordinate system.

claim: CoreXZ is a variant of CoreXY that controls the xz axes instead of the xy axes.
quote: CoreXZ is a variant that resembles CoreXY rotated 90 degrees so that the A/B motors control the xz axes instead of the xy axes.

claim: Delta robot and SCARA are alternative mechanisms used in 3D printers.
quote: Delta robot , a parallel robot mechanism used in delta 3D printers SCARA , a robot arm-like mechanism used in 3D printers

claim: 3D printing speed is a measure of how much material is printed per unit of time.
quote: In 3D printing , the printing speed is a measure for how much material is printed per unit of time.

claim: Fused filament fabrication typically uses mm/s or mm³/s as units for printing speed.
quote: fused filament fabrication typically uses mm/s or mm 3 /s

claim: Stereolithography typically uses mm/h or layers per hour as units for printing speed.
quote: stereolithography typically uses mm/h or layers per hour.

claim: 3D printing speed refers only to the build stage, a subcomponent of the entire 3D printing process.
quote: 3D printing speed refers to only the build stage, a subcomponent of the entire 3D printing process.

claim: The entire 3D printing process includes pre-processing, build, and post-processing stages.
quote: the entire process spans from pre-processing to post-processing stages.

claim: Optimal part orientation can significantly improve key factors affecting total print time.
quote: Determining the optimal part orientation is a common software solution for all additive manufacturing processes.

claim: Adaptive slicing minimizes the staircase effect and improves surface quality.
quote: By adaptively computing the height distribution of layers, this error can be minimized: The quality of surface increases while post-processing time decreases.

claim: Modified printheads and additional lasers can increase 3D printing speed.
quote: Modified printheads: using different types of printheads for different printing processes.

claim: Gel Dispensing Printing technology extrudes gel material hardened by UV-LED curing.
quote: Gel Dispensing Printing technology, which extrudes a gel material immediately hardened by UV-LED curing

claim: Shape optimization is a challenge in 3D printing that affects speed.
quote: Shape optimization . Since a product's interior can be filled using many different structures, design optimization through additive manufacturing is necessary.

claim: Construction 3D printing includes technologies like extrusion, powder bonding, and additive welding.
quote: At construction scale, the main 3D-printing methods are extrusion (concrete/cement, wax, foam, polymers), powder bonding (polymer bond, reactive bond, sintering), and additive welding.

claim: 3D concrete printing can reduce construction time, material usage, and labor requirements.
quote: 3D concrete printing is an emerging technology with the potential to transform building and infrastructure construction by reducing time, material usage, labor requirements, and overall costs.

claim: Construction 3D printing is also known as additive construction.
quote: Alternative terms for this process include "additive construction."

claim: 3D concrete refers specifically to concrete extrusion technologies in construction 3D printing.
quote: "3D Concrete" refers to concrete extrusion technologies whereas autonomous robotic construction System (ARCS), large-scale additive manufacturing (LSAM), and freeform construction (FC) refer to other sub-groups.

claim: 3D printing is used in manufacturing, medicine, architecture, custom art, and design.
quote: 3D printing has developed significantly and can now perform crucial roles in many applications, with the most common applications being manufacturing, medicine, architecture, custom art and design.

claim: 3D printing can replace traditional manufacturing methods that are costly and time-consuming.
quote: Utilizing this technology would replace traditional methods that can be costly and time consuming.

claim: 3D printing allows for customization through modifiable files, beneficial in healthcare applications.
quote: case studies outlining how the customization abilities of 3D printing through modifiable files have been beneficial for cost and time effectiveness in a healthcare applications.

claim: Types of 3D printing include FDM, SLA, SLS, polyjet printing, MJF, DMLS, and EBM.
quote: different types of 3D printing such as fused deposition modeling (FDM), stereolithography (SLA), selective laser sintering (SLS), polyjet printing, multi-jet fusion (MJF), direct metal laser sintering (DMLS), and electron beam melting (EBM).

claim: 3D printing materials range from plastics and polymers to resins and stem cells.
quote: Materials can range from plastic and polymers as thermoplastic filaments, to resins, and even stem cells.

claim: Inkjet printing was initially used for signs and documents before adapting to print metals.
quote: Continuous inkjet technology (CIT) began by printing signs and documents on paper, later adapted to print metals.

claim: Material jetting involves drawing a nozzle across an absorbent surface to deposit material.
quote: In material jetting a nozzle is drawn across an absorbent surface.

claim: Binder jetting, also known as inkjet 3D printing, deposits binding adhesive onto layers of powdered material.
quote: Binder jetting deposits binding adhesive onto layers of powdered material. Also known as inkjet 3D printing.

claim: Laser metal deposition is also known as laser directed energy deposition.
quote: Laser metal deposition ( LMD ) or laser directed energy deposition is an additive manufacturing process.

claim: Laser powder forming is a synonym for laser metal deposition.
quote: Synonyms include laser powder forming and the proprietary laser engineered net shaping.

claim: Laser engineered net shaping is a proprietary synonym for laser metal deposition.
quote: Synonyms include laser powder forming and the proprietary laser engineered net shaping.

claim: Direct metal deposition is a trademarked technique similar to laser metal deposition.
quote: Other trademarked techniques include direct metal deposition (DMD) and laser consolidation (LC).

claim: Laser consolidation is a trademarked technique similar to laser metal deposition.
quote: Other trademarked techniques include direct metal deposition (DMD) and laser consolidation (LC).
